text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Little kitty... Where are you in such a 
rush to go?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, if we chase after it, a grand 
adventure might just begin♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, did you fall asleep? And here I 
thought a grand adventure was about to 
begin...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Satono Diamond searched high 
and low for a new adventure, but couldn't 
find one.
